import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
tsv=S.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query=xref:panther-PTHR13651'
          '&fields=accession,id,organism_name,sequence&format=tsv',timeout=180).text
L=[l.split('\t') for l in tsv.strip().split('\n')]; hdr=L[0]
recs=[dict(zip(hdr,r)) for r in L[1:]]
by_org={}
for r in recs:
    if 150<len(r['Sequence'])<400: by_org.setdefault(r['Organism'],[]).append(r)
MOUSE=[r for r in recs if r['Entry']=='Q80ZQ9'][0]['Sequence']
print(f"mouse Q80ZQ9 len={len(MOUSE)}")
print("mouse 88-105:", "".join(f"{MOUSE[i]}" for i in range(87,105)), " (numbering 88..105)")

# ---------- (e) NLS / RNA-binding motif scan on the mouse sequence ----------
print("\n--- sequence feature scan, mouse Q80ZQ9 ---")
scans={
 'monopartite NLS K(K/R)x(K/R) (PROSITE-style)': r'K[KR].[KR]',
 'classical SV40-type NLS PKKKRKV-like [KR]{4,}': r'[KR]{4,}',
 'bipartite NLS [KR]{2}.{9,12}[KR]{3,5}': r'[KR]{2}.{9,12}[KR]{3,5}',
 'PY-NLS C-terminal R/K/H-x(2-5)-PY': r'[RKH].{2,5}PY',
 'RS dipeptide repeat (SR splicing factor)': r'(?:RS){3,}|(?:SR){3,}',
 'RGG/RG box': r'RG[GF].{0,5}RG[GF]',
 'RRM RNP-1 octamer [RK]G[FY][GA][FY][ILV]x[FY]': r'[RK]G[FY][GA][FY][ILV].[FY]',
 'KH GxxG loop': r'[ILV]GxxG'.replace('x','.'),
 'WH2 actin-binding LKKT/V': r'L[KR][KR][TV]',
 'PxxP SH3 ligand': r'P..P',
 'LD motif (FAK/paxillin) LDxLLxxL': r'LD.LL..L',
}
for name,pat in scans.items():
    hits=[(m.start()+1,m.group()) for m in re.finditer(pat,MOUSE)]
    print(f"  {name:52s}: {len(hits)} hit(s)" + ("  " + "; ".join(f'{s}:{g}' for s,g in hits[:6]) if hits else ""))
# net charge of the disordered termini vs core
def q(s): return sum(1 for c in s if c in 'KR')-sum(1 for c in s if c in 'DE')
print(f"\n  net charge  N-term 1-22: {q(MOUSE[:22]):+d}   core 23-190: {q(MOUSE[22:190]):+d}   C-term 191-193: {q(MOUSE[190:]):+d}")

# ---------- (d) mouse vs human and representative species ----------
WANT=['Homo sapiens','Mus musculus','Danio rerio','Xenopus tropicalis','Gallus gallus',
      'Drosophila melanogaster','Caenorhabditis elegans','Ciona intestinalis',
      'Nematostella vectensis','Arabidopsis thaliana','Dictyostelium discoideum',
      'Saccharomyces cerevisiae','Schizosaccharomyces pombe','Trypanosoma brucei']
bl="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1

-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -2 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rr=bl.split('\n'); AA=rr[0].split(); SUB=np.full((128,128),-4.0)
for a,row in zip(AA,rr[1:]):
    for b,v in zip(AA,row.split()): SUB[ord(a),ord(b)]=float(v)
mo=np.frombuffer(MOUSE.encode(),dtype=np.uint8); n=len(MOUSE); G=-8.0; NEG=-1e9
def nw_diag(b):
    bo=np.frombuffer(b.encode(),dtype=np.uint8); m=len(b); Sm=SUB[np.ix_(mo,bo)]
    H=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    H[0,:]=G*np.arange(m+1); H[:,0]=G*np.arange(n+1); P[0,1:]=2; P[1:,0]=1
    for d in range(2,n+m+1):
        i=np.arange(max(1,d-m),min(n,d-1)+1)
        if not len(i): continue
        j=d-i
        cand=np.stack([H[i-1,j-1]+Sm[i-1,j-1],H[i-1,j]+G,H[i,j-1]+G])
        k=np.argmax(cand,0); H[i,j]=cand[k,np.arange(len(i))]; P[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; col=np.full(n,'-',dtype='<U1')
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=P[i,j]
        if k==0: col[i-1]=b[j-1]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return col
PATCH=[92,96,98,99,128,130,161]
rows=[]
for org in WANT:
    cand=by_org.get(org)
    if not cand: rows.append({'organism':org,'accession':'not in PTHR13651','len':None}); continue
    r=sorted(cand,key=lambda x:-len(x['Sequence']))[0]
    if r['Entry']=='Q80ZQ9':
        rows.append({'organism':org,'accession':r['Entry'],'len':len(MOUSE),'pct_id_vs_mouse':100.0,
                     'core_pct_id':100.0,**{f"{MOUSE[p-1]}{p}":MOUSE[p-1] for p in PATCH}}); continue
    c=nw_diag(r['Sequence']); ml=np.array(list(MOUSE))
    aligned=c!='-'
    rows.append({'organism':org,'accession':r['Entry'],'len':len(r['Sequence']),
                 'pct_id_vs_mouse':round(100*(c==ml).mean(),1),
                 'core_pct_id':round(100*(c[22:190]==ml[22:190]).mean(),1),
                 **{f"{MOUSE[p-1]}{p}":c[p-1] for p in PATCH}})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option('display.width',250)
print("\n--- mouse-anchored ortholog comparison (patch residues) ---")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv('/agent/jobs/7fa3ef47-758c-4d83-8be4-ef31af2ced2a/provenance/ortholog_patch_table.csv',index=False)

hum=[r for r in recs if r['Entry']=='Q9NX38']
if hum:
    c=nw_diag(hum[0]['Sequence']); ml=np.array(list(MOUSE))
    print(f"\nmouse Q80ZQ9 vs human Q9NX38: {100*(c==ml).mean():.1f}% identical over {n} mouse positions; "
          f"core 23-190 {100*(c[22:190]==ml[22:190]).mean():.1f}%; patch residues "
          + ", ".join(f"{MOUSE[p-1]}{p}->{c[p-1]}" for p in PATCH))

ok=df.dropna(subset=['len']).query("accession!='not in PTHR13651'")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.4))
ax.barh(ok.organism,ok.core_pct_id,color='#4878a8')
for i,(o,v) in enumerate(zip(ok.organism,ok.core_pct_id)):
    cons=sum(1 for p in PATCH if ok.iloc[i][f"{MOUSE[p-1]}{p}"] in 'KR')
    ax.text(v+1,i,f"{v:.0f}%  |  {cons}/7 patch residues K or R",va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,135); ax.set_xlabel('% identity to mouse over the ordered core (residues 23-190)')
ax.set_title('Abitram core conservation and basic-patch retention across eukaryotes')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
